name: datagateways
description: DataGateways marketing site — React frontend, Express backend.

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n web,api -c blue,magenta "npm:dev:web" "npm:dev:api"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @datagateways/web && npm run build --workspace @datagateways/api
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
